install.title: Install Lotties
install.intro: Lotties is a web app: you add it from the browser, no app store needed. Installed, it opens full screen from its own icon, like any other app.
install.native: You are using the Lotties app. There is nothing to install.
install.installed: You are already using the installed app.
install.storeNote: If Lotties apps are offered in your phone's app store, they are an alternative to installing from the browser.

button.accepted: Installing Lotties. Open it from its new icon.
button.dismissed: Not installed. You can install it later from here.

sheet.titleIos: Add Lotties to your Home Screen
sheet.title: Install Lotties
sheet.iosHonest: Apple does not let a website install itself on iPhone and iPad, so this takes three taps in the browser.
sheet.safariTip: If you don't see Add to Home Screen, open lotties.app in Safari: it is the most reliable way.

iosSafari.s1: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up). It is in the toolbar at the bottom of the screen; on newer iOS versions it may be under the More button (•••).
iosSafari.s1Tablet: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up) at the top right, next to the address bar.
iosSafari.s2: Scroll down the list and tap Add to Home Screen.
iosSafari.s3: Tap Add, then open Lotties from its new icon on your Home Screen.

iosOther.s1: Tap the Share button, at the top right next to the address bar or inside the browser's menu.

inApp.s1: This page is open inside another app. Tap that app's menu (often ••• at the top right).
inApp.s2: Choose Open in browser: Safari on iPhone and iPad, Chrome on Android.
inApp.s3: Then follow the steps for that browser.

androidChrome.s1: Tap the menu (three dots) at the top right.
androidChrome.s2: Tap Install app (on some phones it says Add to Home screen).
androidChrome.s3: Tap Install, then open Lotties from your Home screen or app list.

androidSamsung.s1: Tap the menu (three lines) at the bottom right.
androidSamsung.s2: Tap Add page to, then Home screen. If an install icon shows in the address bar, you can tap that instead.
androidSamsung.s3: Tap Add, then open Lotties from your Home screen.

androidFirefox.s2: Tap Add to Home screen (it may say Install).
androidFirefox.s3: Confirm, then open Lotties from your Home screen.

desktopChromium.s1: Look for the install icon at the right end of the address bar (a screen with a down arrow).
desktopChromium.s2: Click it, then click Install. No icon? Open the browser menu and look for Install Lotties (in Chrome under Cast, save and share; in Edge under Apps).
desktopChromium.s3: Lotties opens in its own window. You can pin it to the taskbar or the Dock.

macSafari.s1: In the menu bar at the top of the screen, click File.
macSafari.s3: Click Add, then open Lotties from the Dock.

unsupported.s1: This browser cannot install apps from a website.
unsupported.s2: Open lotties.app in Chrome or Edge (or Safari on a Mac) and install it from there.

ios.requirement: Needs iOS or iPadOS 16.4 or later for notifications.
ios.ipad: On iPad, the Share button is at the top right, next to the address bar.
ios.otherBrowsers: On recent iOS versions, Chrome, Edge and Firefox can also add Lotties to the Home Screen from their Share menu. Safari is the most reliable.
ios.whyTitle: Why install on iPhone and iPad
ios.why: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the app added to the Home Screen (iOS and iPadOS 16.4 or later), never in a browser tab. Safari can also delete what a website stores on the device after about a week without visits; the Home Screen app keeps it.

android.notifications: After installing, allow notifications when Lotties asks, or turn them on later in Settings.

trouble.iosMissingTitle: I don't see Add to Home Screen (iPhone, iPad)
trouble.iosMissing: Use the Share button of the browser itself, not a share button inside the page, and scroll the list down: the option is often below the first rows. Private Browsing hides it, so open a normal tab. Still missing? Open lotties.app in Safari.
trouble.androidMissing: Open the page in Chrome itself, not inside Instagram, Facebook or another app's browser: use that app's menu and choose Open in Chrome. If Lotties is already installed, the option does not show: look for it in your app list.
trouble.update: The installed app updates itself when you open it with internet. To check right away, open Hub, then Check for updates.
trouble.uninstall: Phone or tablet: touch and hold the Lotties icon, then choose Remove App or Uninstall. Computer: open Lotties, open its menu in the title bar and choose Uninstall; on a Mac, drag Lotties out of the Dock and delete it from the Applications folder. What is stored only on this device goes with it; what has synced stays in your account.

landing.title: Install on your phone
landing.body: Add Lotties to your iPhone or Android phone: it opens full screen from its own icon, and on iPhone that is how notifications work.
landing.soon: We are still getting Lotties into the App Store and Google Play. For now, installing it from the browser is the easiest way to use it, and it works just like an app.
